Subject: Final cadence: budget and approvals ahead of quarter close?

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before you head into final budget discussions: 

- Use case: internal clinician summarization + patient messaging automation (priority: reduce time spent on notes).
- Expected Q1 usage: ~100k tokens/day initially (pilot 3 clinics), scale to 800k/day if pilot succeeds.
- Success metrics: 30% clinician time saved; FTE reallocation to patient outreach.
- Security needs: HIPAA-safe handling, customer-managed KMS, audit logging for requests.
- Decision process: Clinical ops + IT -> budget owner (CFO) -> procurement; target approval in the last week of this quarter.

Next steps I promised:
1) Attached a tailored proposal and a two-week pilot plan (scope + success metrics).
2) If you want, we can put together a short ROI sketch for your CFO to speed approvals.
3) Proposed pilot kickoff window: Nov 16–23 (to validate performance before month-end).

Attachment: [redwood-proposal-v1.pdf] (high level pricing + pilot SOW)

Would you mind confirming whether the Nov 16 window still looks feasible given your internal timelines? If procurement wants a template SOW or a security checklist, I can loop in our compliance lead.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the recap and the proposal. Quick answers:
- Pilot scope looks good; clinical ops liked the success metrics.
- Procurement asked for a short security checklist and SOC2 evidence (can you send both?).
- Timeline: CFO will review budget next week (week of Nov 9). Honestly hoping to lock something before the Nov 24 payroll cutoff but no promises.

If you can send the SOC2 summary + a one-page SOW template today, I’ll push it into procurement and loop the CFO.
